name: publicWeb_issuePasskeyInviteCode
description: The app's first-install sign-in with a web passkey (E9.F7.S13). After the web has verified the passkey assertion, finds the live device holding @credentialId, makes sure that hasher has a compliant invite code (HC6.nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode, rotating one older than a week — 10080 minutes, James 2026-10-04), and returns it; the app feeds it to its own hcapp_authorizeDevice URC path. No device token: guarded by HC_INTERNAL_SECRET on PublicWebAdminApi, and called only after the signature has been checked.

parameters.name: credentialId
parameters.description: The verified passkey's credential id (base64url). No SQL default.
parameters.typeMismatch: Device.PasskeyCredentialId is NVARCHAR(500); the parameter is wider, so an over-long value simply matches nothing.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always first. success 1 on the happy path; 0 with 1230/12 when no live device (removed = 0) holds the credential; 0 with 1500/5 from the CATCH.
Only on 1230 (passkey not found): errorTitle 'Passkey not found', logged to HC.ErrorLog first. The CATCH (1500/5) returns the envelope alone, with no detail rowset.

rowsets.name: InviteCode
rowsets.description: On success: the hasher's current invite code after nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode.

columns.name: inviteCode
columns.description: HC.Hasher.ResetCode ('URC:' + six A-Z). NULL when the device's hasher is removed (Removed = 1) — success is still 1.

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode @userId, @rotateIfOlderThanMinutes = 10080 — may UPDATE HC.Hasher.ResetCode / ResetCodeLastUpdated (fires HC.Hasher's code-uniqueness trigger).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on passkey-not-found (credential id cut to 60 chars) and in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: @credentialId (line 16) has no SQL default. A caller that omits it fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.

Line 42 reads ResetCode with Removed = 0 while the device lookup (lines 23-25) does not check the hasher, so a live device belonging to a removed hasher returns success = 1 with inviteCode NULL instead of a refusal.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
